firstPaint.label: the first paint: a page of rows, the count, and the six whole-set queries behind the tiles and the charts

pageOnly.label: returning to the unsorted order after a sort — the engine already held those row groups, so this is what a page costs when nothing new has to be read

sorted.label: re-sorting the whole file by arrival delay and fetching the first page of that order

filtered.label: one filtered query: arr_delay >= 60, its count, and the whole-set queries again

note: Measured by tools/serve.mjs, which records every request for a file under data/. GitHub Pages answers 206 the same way.
